description: On-device voice host: libelizainference (llama.cpp/ggml; Paradee-8M TTS with native misaki G2P and eSpeak NG out-of-lexicon fallback, Phonon-2 parakeet-tdt ASR with batch and streaming decode, Silero VAD) through the shared paradee-voice Java API (ai.eliza.voice) and RegisterNatives JNI. The only on-device speech engine; llama.cpp-based, no other neural runtime. These are the exact bytes scripts/android-stage-voice-models.mjs may stage; nothing here claims emulator, device or user acceptance.

bundle.install: Shipped in the APK assets (Paradee GGUF ~32 MB, lexicon, eSpeak NG data, VAD and the Phonon-2 GGUF ~331 MB) and copied to app storage with per-file SHA-256 verification on first use (ai.eliza.voice.VoiceAssets.install). No download.

asrSlot.current: Phonon-2 (Parakeet-TDT 0.6B, five-value weights), elizaOS/eliza#36212 (d06a1aa9c9), consumed at this pin; ELIZA_ASR_BACKEND=parakeet is the APK default (BuildConfig)

evidence.classes: B (APK-input libraries built and symbol-checked on a development machine); no E/I/R/D
evidence.build: Both Android ABIs built on 2026-10-16 from Eliza afd44a8544b4aed3bae7824be5d261270a69540e and llama.cpp 6e6a4401aae473723cb164a3190eebea6526ea6e with NDK 28.2.13676358 using prepare-embedding-host.mjs --build --remap-build-path. Engine and full JNI libraries passed ELF architecture, required symbol and 16 KiB alignment checks; voice ABI 19 with eliza_inference_paradee_supported, eliza_inference_paradee_stream_supported and eliza_inference_asr_supported all 1, 87 eliza_inference_* exports including six asr_stream_* and the Paradee stream exports. The full JNI registers nativeParadeeSynthesizeStream. Voice-subset JNI bridges built by Gradle :local-speech:assembleRelease export only JNI_OnLoad with 16 KiB alignment. Model, lexicon and voice data assets keep their recorded hashes. No host, Android emulator or device execution is claimed at this pin.
evidence.hostGates: Not rerun at this pin (new engine, no host or Android execution). Earlier host evidence for the same Phonon-2 GGUF (elizaOS/eliza#36212, macOS arm64, an earlier engine): batch and streaming transcripts exact under -Xcheck:jni, Paradee to Phonon-2 round trip exact. Host evidence only; not Android execution.

acceptance: Not qualified; needs human review. Requires on-device qualification on both ABIs (packages/app/scripts/paradee-voice/qualify: ASR WER and Paradee round trip with Phonon-2) and device/user acceptance before qualified may become true. Nothing in this repository sets it.

sourceCompatibility.basis: Pin 08703642627c (eliza develop, 2026-10-16) adds the Alpha end-of-turn route (elizaOS/eliza#36546), heard-only assistant content (#36547), period-allowance resets in chat failures (#36549) and the Maps admission latency harness (#36556) above afd44a8544b4. The llama.cpp gitlink (6e6a4401aae4), every native build input, the elizavoice-jni Java class and bun.lock are byte-identical, so the engine and JNI bytes recorded here, built at afd44a8544b4, are the bytes this pin builds. Build inspection only; no host, emulator or device execution is claimed.
